summary.name: PocketBase
summary.one_liner: PocketBase is an open source backend distributed as a single file, bundling a realtime database, authentication, file storage and an admin dashboard.
use_cases: Self-hosted user authentication with OAuth2 sign-in
Storing and serving files and media attached to records
Rapid prototyping with a built-in admin UI
summary.what_it_does:
PocketBase is an embedded database-backed backend with a schema builder, data validations, realtime subscriptions and a REST API. It manages app users with email/password sign-up and OAuth2 providers (Google, Facebook, GitHub, GitLab). Files can be stored locally or in S3-compatible storage, attached to database records, and thumbnails generated on the fly. It can be used as a standalone app or as a framework extended with Go and JavaScript hooks. The page includes a JavaScript SDK example for listing, fetching, creating, deleting and subscribing to collection records.</what_it_does>
